newsitem.title: USA: Game Financial wins casino contracts.
newsitem.headline: Game Financial wins casino contracts.

text.p: Game Financial Corp said Tuesday it has received a temporary supplier's license from the Indiana Gaming Commission which will allow the company to offer check cashing services to Indiana casino gaming properties.

The company also said it has agreed to provide check cashing services at Hyatt's Grand Victoria Casino in Rising Sun, Ind. The company's check cashing operation is expected to become operational during the first quarter.

In another development, Game Financial said it has received a contract to provide its credit card cash advance services at Fiesta Casino & Hotel in Las Vegas, Nev. The company will install its systems in the first quarter of 1997.

The company is currently operating in 76 locations, up from 28 at the end of 1995. Including the locations announced today, Game Financial Corporation has agreements in place with four additional gaming establishments that will become operational during the first quarter of 1997.

Game Financial provides casinos with services that allow their patrons to access cash through the use of credit card cash advance services, check cashing services and automated teller machines (ATMs).
